question: The particles that form the main part of the nucleus of an atom are together known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**nucleons**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The particles that form the main part of the nucleus of an atom are known as **nucleons**.
 
• **Nucleons** include both protons and neutrons, which are held together by the strong nuclear force.
